craft_notes: Sthāyin: arrival-joy (raising declared). Sanskrit first: path (base-middle to suṣumnā), seal (raising declared), opening (awakening beyond) → L4 sets path line 1, seal+opening line 2. Rows: row 1 (beyond-last — 'beyond' closes as paratas closes). Rupture: dash after 'way' — journey walked, seal stamped. Close: suspended (no period-weight; awakening waits — the song must wait too). Minimal pass: 'central way' for suṣumnāmārga (singable road, Sanskrit in cite). Read aloud: line 1 walks (risen/holds), dash, line 2 seals then opens. Rejected: naming suṣumnā aloud — killed: L4 sings English, the channel-name stays in the cite; period close — killed: Sanskrit opens (paratastathā), song stays open.

lines: From the base's middle risen, she holds the central way —
this is raising sealed, and awakening waits beyond.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādhāramadhyādāyātā suṣumnāmārgam āśritā / utthāpanaṃ samākhyātaṃ bodhanaṃ paratastathā

reads_against.argmap: Raising is declared in her path from base to channel; awakening lies beyond.
c1_essence: From the base-middle into the suṣumnā road — raising declared, awakening beyond.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta strained toward bhayānaka (wonder edged with fear)
